mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trips (user_id, title, start_date, end_date, region, theme, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{region}, #{theme}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE trips SET title = #{title}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, region = #{region}, theme = #{theme}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
